senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of צור, cmp. אסר)to lock up, hoard, gather; cmp. גָּנַז.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 90b:4">B. Bath. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹצְרֵי פירות</he> those who store up fruit (for speculation).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 90b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אין אוֹצְרִין וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:1">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:1">V</cite>), 1 (<cite ref="A02889"><he>אצר</he></cite> a. <he>עצר</he> used promiscuously) you must not hoard up (for speculation) such things as are necessaries of life; [correct <he>אין א׳ דברים שיש … כגון יינות שמנים וסלתות ופירות</he>].
Ib. לא יְאַצֵּר Pi. (Tosef. ולא יַעֲצוֹר, read לא; Var. לא יַאֲצִיר).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:9">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> end (play on <he>נבוכדרא̇צ̇ר̇</he>) <he>שאֲצָרָן וכ׳</he> he locked them up in the desert &c.—
Y. Dem. VI, end, 26ᵃ; Tosef. ib. VI, 4; Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ אוֹצֵר (עוֹצֵר) government’s store-collector, commissary (apothecarius), or read אוֹצָר q. v.
